name: piper-handeye-calibration
description: Automatic eye-in-hand hand-eye calibration for AgileX Piper X with RealSense and ChArUco.
requires: agx_arm_ws built with agx_arm_ctrl, agx_arm_msgs, pyAgxArm
safety: ctrl_mode must be 1 (CAN control), never teach mode
never call /exit_teach_mode; it homes the arm to zero
do not run MoveIt during calibration
keep the board fixed and the workspace clear
assumptions: eye-in-hand camera rigidly mounted on the flange
driver tcp_offset=0, so TCP is the flange
ChArUco 7x5, 30 mm squares, 22 mm markers, DICT_4X4_50
